# Summary tables

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)

# Helper functions
se_for_average <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
}

se_for_proportion <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  pbar <- mean(x)
  sqrt(pbar * (1 - pbar) / length(x))
}

project_folder <- "C:/Users/mojde/Desktop/Documents/BIOS-6624-Projects/Project4"

table_folder <- file.path(project_folder, "Results", "Tables")
figure_folder <- file.path(project_folder, "Results", "Figures")

# Load saved simulation results
by_variable <- readRDS(
  file.path(table_folder, "sim_results_by_variable.rds")
)

by_model <- readRDS(
  file.path(table_folder, "sim_results_by_model.rds")
)

signal_variables <- paste0("X", 1:5)
noise_variables <- paste0("X", 6:20)

method_labels <- c(
  "Backward p-value" = "Backward",
  "Backward AIC" = "AIC",
  "Backward BIC" = "BIC",
  "LASSO: lambda.min" = "LASSO min",
  "LASSO: lambda.1se" = "LASSO 1se",
  "Elastic net: lambda.min" = "EN min",
  "Elastic net: lambda.1se" = "EN 1se"
)
```


## Method-level performance

This table gives the average TP, FP, FN, and TN counts for each combination of sample size, correlation, and method. The rates are also included to make the counts easier to compare across methods.



```{r appendix-table-A5-method-performance}
appendix_A1 <- by_model %>%
  group_by(sample_size, rho, method) %>%
  summarize(
    TPR = mean(true_positive_rate),
    FPR = mean(false_positive_rate),
    Size = mean(model_size),
    Exact = mean(exact_recovery),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),

    Scenario = case_when(
      sample_size == 250 & rho == 0 ~ "250, 0",
      sample_size == 250 & rho == 0.35 ~ "250, 0.35",
      sample_size == 250 & rho == 0.70 ~ "250, 0.70",
      sample_size == 500 & rho == 0 ~ "500, 0",
      sample_size == 500 & rho == 0.35 ~ "500, 0.35",
      sample_size == 500 & rho == 0.70 ~ "500, 0.70"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample_size, rho, Method)

write.csv(
  appendix_A1,
  file.path(
    table_folder,
    "Appendix_Table_A1_Method_Performance.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

appendix_A1 %>%
  select(
    Scenario,
    Method,
    TPR,
    FPR,
    Size,
    Exact
  ) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 3,
    col.names = c(
      "N, ρ",
      "Method",
      "TPR",
      "FPR",
      "Size",
      "Exact"
    ),
    caption = "Appendix Table A1. Compact method-level selection performance by simulation scenario. TPR = true positive rate among truly associated predictors; FPR = false positive rate among null predictors; Size = average number of selected predictors; Exact = probability of exact model recovery.",
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 8
  ) %>%
  collapse_rows(
    columns = 1,
    valign = "top"
  )
```







```{r appendix-table-A2}
appendix_A2 <- by_variable %>%
  filter(variable %in% signal_variables) %>%
  group_by(sample_size, rho, method, variable, beta_true) %>%
  summarize(
    selection_probability = mean(chosen),
    mean_bias = mean(unconditional_bias, na.rm = TRUE),
    coverage = mean(ci_covers_truth, na.rm = TRUE),
    type_II_error = mean(type_II_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
    Scenario = paste0("N = ", sample_size, ", rho = ", rho)
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample_size, rho, Method, variable)

write.csv(
  appendix_A2,
  file.path(table_folder, "Appendix_Table_A2.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

appendix_A2 %>%
  select(
    Scenario,
    Method,
    Variable = variable,
    Beta = beta_true,
    Select = selection_probability,
    Bias = mean_bias,
    Cover = coverage,
    TypeII = type_II_error
  ) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 3,
    caption = "Appendix Table A2. Variable-level performance for truly associated predictors. Results are shown separately by simulation scenario. Select = selection probability; Bias = unconditional bias; Cover = empirical confidence interval coverage; TypeII = Type II error rate.",
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 8
  ) %>%
  collapse_rows(
    columns = 1,
    valign = "top"
  )
```




```{r appendix-table-A3}

appendix_A3 %>%

    Variable = variable,
    FPR = false_positive_rate,

  ) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 3,
    caption = "Appendix Table A3. Variable-level false positive performance for null predictors. Results are shown separately by simulation scenario. FPR = false positive selection rate; TypeI = Type I error rate after post-selection OLS refitting.",

```




```{r appendix-mcse-table}
appendix_mcse <- by_model %>%
  group_by(sample_size, rho, method) %>%
  summarize(
    mcse_TPR = se_for_average(true_positive_rate),
    mcse_FPR = se_for_average(false_positive_rate),
    mcse_model_size = se_for_average(model_size),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    by_variable %>%
      filter(beta_true != 0) %>%
      group_by(sample_size, rho, method) %>%
      summarize(
        mcse_bias = se_for_average(unconditional_bias),
        mcse_coverage = se_for_proportion(ci_covers_truth),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("sample_size", "rho", "method")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
    Scenario = paste0("N = ", sample_size, ", rho = ", rho)
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample_size, rho, Method)

write.csv(
  appendix_mcse,
  file.path(table_folder, "Appendix_MCSE_Table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

appendix_mcse %>%
  select(
    Scenario,
    Method,
    `TPR` = mcse_TPR,
    `FPR` = mcse_FPR,
    `Size` = mcse_model_size,
    `Bias` = mcse_bias,
    `Cover` = mcse_coverage
  ) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Appendix Table A4. Monte Carlo standard errors for key simulation performance measures. Smaller values indicate greater numerical precision of the simulation estimates.",
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 8
  ) %>%
  collapse_rows(
    columns = 1,
    valign = "top"
  )
```

## Overall inference summary


```{r appendix-table-A5-overall-inference}
overall_inference_summary <- by_variable %>%
  group_by(sample_size, rho, method) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_type_I_error = mean(type_I_error[beta_true == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    mcse_type_I_error = se_for_proportion(type_I_error[beta_true == 0]),

    mean_type_II_error = mean(type_II_error[beta_true != 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    mcse_type_II_error = se_for_proportion(type_II_error[beta_true != 0]),

    mean_bias_signal_variables = mean(unconditional_bias[beta_true != 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_coverage_signal_variables = mean(ci_covers_truth[beta_true != 0], na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
    Scenario = paste0("N = ", sample_size, ", rho = ", rho)
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample_size, rho, Method)

write.csv(
  overall_inference_summary,
  file.path(table_folder, "Appendix_Table_A4_Overall_Inference.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

overall_inference_summary %>%
  select(
    Scenario,
    Method,
    `Type I` = mean_type_I_error,
    `Type II` = mean_type_II_error,
    Bias = mean_bias_signal_variables,
    Coverage = mean_coverage_signal_variables
  ) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 3,
    caption = "Appendix Table A5. Overall post-selection inference performance by simulation scenario and selection method. Type I error is averaged across null predictors (X6–X20), while Type II error, bias, and coverage are averaged across truly associated predictors (X1–X5). Bias is unconditional, treating unselected predictors as having estimated coefficients equal to zero.",
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 8
  ) %>%
  collapse_rows(
    columns = 1,
    valign = "top"
  )
```
